name: Panic Attacks
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of fear and anxious thoughts but consistently points believers to trust and reliance on God as the true source of comfort and deliverance. The Psalms remind us that even in the darkest and most fearful moments, God’s presence and care bring peace and sustainment, encouraging us to cast our burdens upon Him and find delight in His comforts. Proverbs reinforces this by urging wholehearted trust in the Lord rather than leaning on our own understanding, while the call to be still and recognize God’s sovereignty offers a foundation of calm amidst panic.
